Manufacturing Process and Quality Control

Our manufacturing cycle begins with the careful sourcing of raw, green bananas from verified agricultural networks. First, skilled technicians peel, wash, and slice the fresh green bananas. Next, low-temperature dehydration preserves the vital nutrients, dietary fiber, and delicate natural profile. Finally, advanced milling and pulverizing systems achieve the ideal particle fineness. As leading green banana powder manufacturers in india, we implement rigorous batch testing protocols. Every kilogram undergoes moisture checks and microbial analysis before final packaging. We take pride in our raw banana powder wholesale solutions, which satisfy the strict demands of health food brands. Furthermore, our raw banana flour suppliers program guarantees complete traceability from farm to factory. Because we control the entire production chain, our clients enjoy superior shelf stability and dependable product consistency.

Key Technical Specifications and Characteristics

Understanding product specifications is vital for industrial formulation. Our raw banana powder features a uniform light cream to off-white appearance. In addition, it boasts a neutral, mildly starchy flavor profile that blends seamlessly into various recipes. The moisture content remains strictly controlled below 8 percent to prevent caking. Moreover, our standard 80 to 100 mesh size ensures smooth texturizing in commercial kitchens and manufacturing plants.
  • Purity: 100% natural ingredient with zero artificial additives or preservatives.
  • Mesh Size: 80–100 mesh for optimal solubility and blending.
  • Moisture: Below 8% for extended shelf-life security.
  • Shelf Life: 24 months when stored under recommended conditions.

Versatile Applications Across Industries

Food developers utilize our wholesale raw banana powder in numerous formulations. For instance, the bakery industry incorporates it into gluten-free breads, cookies, and energy bars. Meanwhile, the nutraceutical sector uses it as a rich source of prebiotic resistant starch. In addition, infant food manufacturers rely on its gentle digestibility and wholesome profile. Because of its versatility, beverage brands also add it to functional smoothies and health shakes.

Packaging Options and Global Export Support

We understand that proper packaging protects product integrity during long transit times. Therefore, we offer export-grade packaging options including 1 kg stand-up pouches, 5 kg bags, 25 kg multi-wall paper sacks, and HDPE drums. Each container features tamper-evident seals and clear labeling with batch numbers and production dates. Furthermore, our dedicated logistics team manages all necessary export documentation for smooth customs clearance.
